about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: The initial image literal for FD XREFFILE-REC in Cbact04cService is dead because 0100-XREF-FILE-OPEN and subsequent reads populate the buffer before use.
The initial image literal for FD TRANFILE-REC is dead because 1300-B-WRITE-TX explicitly populates all transaction fields before writing to TRANFILE.
The initial image literal for TCATBALF-STATUS is dead because 0000-TCATBALF-OPEN executes OPEN INPUT TCATBALF which writes status before any branch check.
The initial image literal for TRAN-RECORD in Cbact04cService is dead because 1300-B-WRITE-TX initializes and formats the entire transaction record before use.
The initial image literal for TRANFILE-STATUS is dead because 0500-TRANFILE-OPEN immediately sets TRANFILE-STATUS via OPEN OUTPUT TRANSACT.

survivors.before: private final Field f120_DB2_MIN = Field.alphanumeric(s_DB2_FORMAT_TS, 14, 2, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f120_DB2_MIN = Field.alphanumeric(s_DB2_FORMAT_TS, 14, 3, false);
survivors.reason: f120_DB2_MIN length expansion into byte 16 of s_DB2_FORMAT_TS is dead because 1300-B-WRITE-TX immediately overwrites byte 16 with dot separator f121_DB2_DOT_2.
In id_CardXrefRecord, key extraction helper failure falls back to linear scan in DetFiles.Indexed, locating the identical matching record.
In initialState(), the arraycopy for TCATBALF-STATUS is dead because 0000-TCATBALF-OPEN immediately sets TCATBALF-STATUS upon file open.
The initialState arraycopy for COBOL-TS is dead because 1300-B-WRITE-TX fetches the current timestamp and moves it into COBOL-TS before any read.
runProgram() is an uncalled standalone runner never invoked during batch execution, which enters exclusively through runBatch.
Writing parameter length to byte 2 of s_EXTERNAL_PARMS is dead because System.arraycopy immediately overwrites byte 2 with the parameter text.
Changing bounds subtraction to addition in parm arraycopy is an identity because parmText length 10 is strictly less than both 10 and 14.

survivors.reason: Mutating keyOffset in DetFiles.Indexed disables byId optimization and falls back to scanning records, which returns the exact same matching record.
The performThru array expansion in perform() is guarded by mine == performThru.length (capacity 64), which is never reached since perform depth never exceeds 2.
In perform(), the increment d++ in the loop tail is never executed because paragraph returns in CBACT04C never satisfy i != thru.
The loop condition d < 0 in perform() is never reached because all PERFORM calls in CBACT04C execute paragraphs that exit without active thru ranges.
The perform loop tail condition d > 0 is never evaluated because CBACT04C only uses single-paragraph perform invocations where i == thru.
In perform(), the reverse search loop tail is entered only when a paragraph returns with i != thru, which no PERFORM statement in CBACT04C does.
In perform(), testing performThru[d] != i in the search loop is unreachable because CBACT04C performs are simple single-paragraph invocations.
In perform(), testing next < 23 in the paragraph bounds check is unreachable because CBACT04C perform statements never return with i != thru.
In perform(), testing next > 23 is unreachable because the paragraph dispatcher loop tail is never entered for single-paragraph performs.
In perform(), testing e.depth == mine in the PerformExit handler is unreachable because PerformExit is never thrown in CBACT04C.
In the paragraph dispatch switch of perform(), the default arm is unreachable because all paragraph indices in CBACT04C are between 0 and 22.
f132_WS_RECORD_COUNT is a write-only tracking counter updated during TCATBALF processing that is never read or displayed anywhere in CBACT04C.
In 0100-XREF-FILE-OPEN, f97_APPL_RESULT is assigned 12 on open error, but 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM immediately follows and abends without APPL-RESULT being read.
In 0500-TRANFILE-OPEN, setting APPL-RESULT to 8 is dead because successful open immediately overwrites it with 0 and failure overwrites it with 12.
In 0500-TRANFILE-OPEN failure path, APPL-RESULT is set to 12 before abend; if deleted, APPL-RESULT remains 8 so isApplAok() still fails and abends identically.
Paragraph 21 is 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM which terminates unconditionally with CobolAbend.user, so paragraph 22 in the extended range is never reached.
On indexed ACCTFILE read, VSAM only returns status 00 or 23; terms 21, 22, and 24 are impossible, so st12.equals("23") evaluates true in both expressions.
On indexed XREFFILE read, status 22 (duplicate key) is never returned, so replacing literal 22 with X2 has no observable effect.
On indexed XREFFILE read, VSAM only returns status 00 or 23; terms 21, 22, and 24 are impossible, so st13.equals("23") evaluates true in both expressions.
On indexed DISCGRP read, VSAM only returns status 00 or 23; terms 21, 22, and 24 are impossible, so st14.equals("23") evaluates true in both expressions.
On indexed DISCGRP read, status 24 (boundary violation) is never returned, so mutating literal 24 to X4 has no observable effect.
Paragraph 21 is 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM which terminates execution unconditionally via CobolAbend.user, so paragraph 22 in the extended range is never reached.
Paragraph 12 (1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST) is invoked via perform(12, 12); perform exits immediately when i == thru without evaluating the paragraph return value.
f78_TRAN_MERCHANT_CITY occupies bytes 202-252 of s_TRAN_RECORD which are already initialized to spaces by IMAGE_s_TRAN_RECORD, making this move an identity.
In 9000-TCATBALF-CLOSE close error path, setting APPL-RESULT to 12 is followed immediately by 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM without APPL-RESULT ever being read.
In 9200-DISCGRP-CLOSE, setting APPL-RESULT to 8 is dead because successful close overwrites it with 0 and close failure immediately overwrites it with 12.
In 9200-DISCGRP-CLOSE failure path, deleting the 12 store leaves APPL-RESULT at 8, so isApplAok() still fails and invokes 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM identically.
Paragraph 17 (9200-DISCGRP-CLOSE) is called via perform(17, 17); single-paragraph performs exit immediately when i == thru without reading return value next.
